description: This file is a script for generating a bank reconciliation statement report within an ERP system, specifically for the Frappe/ERPNext framework. It includes functions to fetch and process journal and payment entries related to a specified account and date, assemble report columns, and compute balances and discrepancies. The script ties closely to the ERP system's database and conventions, indicating it's a core report generation source file.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main function to generate the bank reconciliation statement columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns()
methods.description: Defines and returns the list of columns for the report.

methods.name: get_entries(filters)
methods.description: Fetches journal entries, payment entries, and POS transactions related to the specified account and date.

methods.name: get_amounts_not_reflected_in_system(filters)
methods.description: Calculates discrepancies not reflected in the system for the specified account and date range.

methods.name: get_balance_row(label, amount, account_currency)
methods.description: Creates a formatted row for balance or discrepancy amounts in the report.
